_notice: REAL, NAMED restaurants. Every name, address, cuisine, and review-count figure below is a public fact pulled from search results and cited by source URL. What this is NOT: a full Public Trust Score. Star-rating sentiment, review-authenticity, reservation-demand, and freshness data are NOT included here because Yelp and Tripadvisor block automated fetching of their pages (robots.txt) and no licensed API is connected yet (see docs/source-policy/approved-sources.md). Getting real, safe-to-publish scores for real businesses requires either manual verification against the source pages (someone reading the actual page and confirming the number) or a licensed API like Google Places. Publishing a full 50-100 'trust score' for a real business on anything less than that is a defamation risk this file deliberately avoids. Coordinates are neighborhood-center approximations, not geocoded street addresses -- see field note on each entry.
